REFERENCE IMAGE: STYLE ONLY, not subject instructions. Match the bold clean dark outlines, chibi proportions, soft pastel colors and warm cream ground. All subjects below are NEW designs; DO NOT reproduce reference characters or reference props.
Create EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 EQUAL cells, row-major order, square canvas. Full bleed grid with NO external margin or gutters. No labels, text, numbers, lines, borders, watermarks, logos, or speech balloons. Each full-body subject centered in its own square cell with 10% safe padding, no cropping, no overlap across cells. All cells same quiet warm-cream background.
Each character must have the PARTICULAR facial expression, distinctive body language and story action below. Strong silhouette variety: standing, seated, crouched, midair, leaning, curled, large and small bodies. Do NOT make everyone smile or hold things the same way. NO notebooks, NO clipboards, NO books, NO repeated tea trays, NO artist palettes. Medicine-inspired motifs are fantasy storytelling, not medical instruments or treatment scenes.
